**PotentialWax 1.3.0**

- **Three looks.** A new default look, **Print Plate** (a warm printed panel), plus **Night Rack** (dark rack unit) and **Colour Block** (flat, big type), each in PotentialWax's own colour. Pick one with the big LOOK keys on the SETUP page; it shows the next time the plugin loads (take it off and add it again, or load your project again), and it is remembered on your MPC for every project.
- Sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged. One parameter was added at the end of the list (LOOK); it is never saved in a project.
- **Akai's plugin folder format** for MPC OS 3.10.1 and later: a second download (`-akai-vst2.zip`) with 32-bit and 64-bit builds, so it now also runs on Gen2 MPCs. Copy the folder into `VST2 Plugins` and turn on External Plugin Support: no hacking needed.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialWax-1.3.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialWax-1.3.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/issues/new/choose).
